sections.heading: Meaning
sections.text: The round white sign with a red ring means: no vehicles of any kind ( Verbot für Fahrzeuge aller Art ). The sign below says why: this is the access road for the fire brigade ( Feuerwehrzufahrt ). It must always stay clear, so never park or stop here. The small yellow sign marks a gas valve under the ground. On the wall, an arrow shows the way to the spectators' entrance ( Zuschauereingang ).
